name: uptime
summary: Shows how long the system has been running, and its load.
description: Prints the time, how long it has been since the last boot, the number of logged-in users and the load average over 1, 5 and 15 minutes. The load is the average number of processes using or waiting for the CPU: compare it with the number of cores (nproc). A load of 4 on a 4-core machine means it is fully busy.

options.description: Prints only the uptime, spelled out.
Prints the date and time of the boot.
